notes.title: 25092023 Update - New Challenges
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 4 new challenges.
[olist]
[*] Colorless
  All cores are gray in color. Find them by their symbols.
[*] Glitch
  Colors of all cores change every 5 moves. Find them by their symbols.
[*] Targeting
  3 cores are targeted in every 5 moves. The targeted cores must be broken within 10 moves. The cores are shuffle in every 3 moves.
[*] Explosive
  An explosive is spawned every 3 moves. The resulting explosive must be broken within 5 moves.
[/olist][*] Added adjustable features for Challenge-Free mode.
[*] Total of 32 new achievements have been added. (8''' + 8', in-game - general).
[*] UI update has been made.
[/list]
